course.title: Unit 3 Places we live in--Lesson B-【例句】
course.description: Unit 3 Places we live in--Lesson B-【例句】

sentences.content: Wow! There are so many books.
sentences.english: Wow ! There are so many books

sentences.content: There is a taijiquan club. There is a gym too.
sentences.english: There is a taijiquan club . There is a gym too
sentences.chinese: 这里有一个太极拳俱乐部，还有一个健身房。
太好了！我们来做些运动吧。

sentences.content: There is a playground in my community. I often do sports there.
sentences.english: There is a playground in my community . I often do sports there
sentences.chinese: 我的社区里有一个游乐场。我经常在那里做运动。

sentences.content: There is a beautiful park. I often take a walk there.
sentences.english: There is a beautiful park . I often take a walk there
sentences.chinese: 那里有一座美丽的公园。我经常在那儿散步。

sentences.content: There is a shop. I go shopping there.
sentences.english: There is a shop . I go shopping there
sentences.chinese: 那里有一家商店。我常去那里购物。

wordDetails.definition: 购物（现在分词）: 购物

sentences.content: There is a hospital. I see a doctor there.
sentences.english: There is a hospital . I see a doctor there
sentences.chinese: 那里有一家医院。我在那里看医生。

sentences.content: My favourite place is the museum.
sentences.english: My favourite place is the museum
sentences.chinese: 我最喜欢的地方是博物馆。

sentences.content: There are many old things and photos. I can read stories about them.
sentences.english: There are many old things and photos . I can read stories about them
sentences.chinese: 这里有许多旧物件和老照片，我能读到关于它们的故事。

sentences.content: There is also a nice shop. People buy gifts and books there.
sentences.english: There is also a nice shop . People buy gifts and books there
sentences.chinese: 这里还有一家不错的商店，人们会在那里购买礼物和书籍。

sentences.content: The museum is in a nice park. We often play in the park. I love that museum!
sentences.english: The museum is in a nice park . We often play in the park . I love that museum !
sentences.chinese: 博物馆坐落在一个美丽的公园里。我们经常在公园里玩耍。我太爱那座博物馆了！

wordDetails.definition: be（现在时第三人称单数）: 是
